note: From the league's Sleeper chat, 2020–2026. Quotes lightly trimmed.
timeline: The 2020 startup draft: 10 teams, 1QB, keeper format.
Poll on 4- vs 6-point rushing touchdowns: 6 points won 5–3. "We're keeping the same rules." — colek23
"4 man playoff next year" lost 5–1. A January 2021 poll kept six playoff teams, 5–2.
"Two qbs in lineup next year?" — Nah 4, Yeah 2.
"pure dynasty" passed 5–3. Same day, "would you be open to superflex?" got 6 yes, 2 no, but nothing changed yet. "It would literally make my team unfair." — maxrottinghaus
"Snake is stupid for rookie draft." — natelivingston. Trevor Lawrence went 1.10, Trey Lance 3.03.
"max pf" passed 4–2 to stop tanking; "league median" failed 5–2. "League median is massively stupid." — maxrottinghaus

Poll "official superflex switch": 4–0. A redo of the rookie draft failed 4–1, and "superflex" passed with 4 yes and 3 "yes but we need to compensate." "We just switched to superflex after the rookie draft, after a whole year, after tlaw got drafted at 1.10, after tua got traded for 18 faab, after trey lance at 3.3." — natelivingston

declanbrady24 regretted his Dallas Goedert–Will Fuller swap within minutes and pushed to veto his own trade. "That might be the worst trade to ever be accepted in this league." — maxrottinghaus. The league upheld it 5–0.
"should we change from snake in 24" passed 5–1.
Lawrence went through six teams in four minutes, each adding a throw-in.
A three-team deal was redone nine minutes later. "You traded one of the best prospects in college history and a top 3 dynasty wr for Le'Veon Bell and Michael Thomas." — georgebez
To settle the Week 17 result and draft order, the league voted to sim the game on Madden (3 votes) over using Week 18 points (2).
Raise to $50 won 4–3; confirmed 5–2 that August.
The toilet-bowl trophy was renamed "The Hook Cup" after colinhook's third straight. "We just have never seen such a dominant team in that tournament."
New payouts and a draft lottery
"change money and payouts" passed 8–1; "Lottery for draft" 5–3; taxi squad failed 5–2.
"expansion to 12" passed 8–1, with two new owners buying in through an expansion draft. Weeks of fighting over rules followed, and "kick jonny and matt?" passed 8–2 on July 30.
"I cant believe we used to just do snake draft for rookie draft 🤣" — natelivingston
"We do max pf for a reason. If you're tanking you gotta have nothing on your team." — colinhook
